mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with triggered labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 55% of tightening cycle instances with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $300,000 million MoM indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the monetary regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with RSAFS MoM growth > $300,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2% YoY, the monetary policy's hawkish stance with controlled inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with triggered monetary conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE increase of more than 0.5pp in 2 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of late-cycle instances with UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST by more than 10% YoY indicates weakening housing demand, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with HOUST YoY decline > 10%.
